epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from undocumented/manual to a single docker-compose up command with 100% startup success rate
epics.tocConstraintRef: local environment setup blocking end-to-end verification
requirements: R1: A docker-compose.yml file must be present at the repository root to start the full stack
R2: A health-check endpoint must be exposed to verify the system is running

slices.title: Add Docker Compose and health check for full stack execution
slices.jtbd: When implementing the local containerization for this epic, I want to provide a docker-compose file, so that the full stack can be launched reliably
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean checkout of the repository
When a user runs docker-compose up
Then the backend, frontend, and database start successfully
Given the running stack
When a request is made to the health-check endpoint
Then a healthy status is returned
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% container startup success without manual configuration

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated protocol count to 0 by enabling immediate update/delete actions
epics.tocConstraintRef: inability to remove obsolete epidemiological protocols from the active catalog
requirements: R1: The UI must allow updating an existing epidemiological material
R2: The UI must allow deleting an existing epidemiological material

slices.title: Implement UI controls for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add edit and delete buttons, so that obsolete records can be removed or modified
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog view
When a user clicks the edit button and submits changes
Then the frontend invokes the PUT API and updates the view
Given an existing material in the catalog view
When a user clicks delete and confirms
Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API and removes it from the view
slices.tocConstraintRef: manual database edits required for content maintenance
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% functional coverage of CRUD operations in the UI

epics.title: Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to 0% by enforcing strict authentication gates
requirements: R1: The system must require users to log in before accessing the catalog or creating a material
R2: Unauthenticated users attempting to access protected resources must be blocked and redirected to login

slices.title: Implement authentication gate for sensitive resources
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to add an authentication interceptor, so that all protected routes enforce identity verification
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
Given an authenticated user
When they access the catalog
Then they are granted access
slices.tocConstraintRef: security vulnerability due to lack of auth
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% block rate for unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints
